Extensions launched by `gh` now get `GH_EXTENSION=1` in their environment. Running the same binary on its own leaves it unset, so a Go extension can check `os.Getenv("GH_EXTENSION") == "1"` to choose which usage text to show. Nothing has been compiled or tested.

The variable is set in `Manager.Dispatch` on top of the existing environment, so all other variables still pass through. That covers both `gh <extname>` and `gh extension exec <extname>`.

The value is `1`, as the issue proposes. Using the extension's name as the value would give more information, but I didn't do that.
